title: Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta
description: Lemony, garlicky shrimp tossed with spaghetti in a glossy butter sauce.

items: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
1/2 cup dry white wine or chicken broth
Cook the spaghetti in well-salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve 1 cup of pasta water, then drain.

Meanwhile, pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and pepper. Heat the oil and 1 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the shrimp 1–2 minutes per side until just pink. Transfer to a plate.
Lower the heat to medium. Add 1 tbsp butter, the garlic and pepper flakes and cook 1 minute until the garlic is golden.
Pour in the wine and simmer 2 minutes until reduced by half.
Add the pasta, remaining butter, lemon juice and zest, and a splash of pasta water. Toss until glossy, adding more water if needed.
Return the shrimp, add the parsley and Parmesan, and toss once more. Serve right away.
